documents.title: Community Q&A: how many field-validation hours does RIC really require?
documents.snippet: A member states that RIC certificates only require 40 supervised field-validation hours and that the network baseline is the only hard number.

documents.title: RIC-POL-03 — Network-wide standards baseline
documents.snippet: All member organisations must document a minimum of 40 supervised field-validation hours for certification applications.

documents.title: IM-DIV-07 — Industrial Monitoring Division certification requirements
documents.snippet: The Industrial Monitoring Division requires a minimum of 72 supervised field-validation hours for submissions it processes.
